title: Keep speculative draft-size fixtures within bounded storage and memory
goal: Bound structural draft-selection test fixtures using File::set_len instead of multi-gigabyte zero-vector writes while preserving real 4,096-byte tiny-fixture bytes and selector assertions (landed in f667919cf899840217dccdd6f15fddb3152a85fc; crates/susi-gemi/src/engines/speculative.rs later migrated out of Lean Core to Commercial susi-gpu-fabric in a5c4be5f3bd77876e76484231671cac499ffb86c, leaving crates/susi-gemi/src/engines/runtime_native.rs as Core's decoupled native routing boundary).
notes: Original bounded structural draft fixture storage landed in f667919cf899840217dccdd6f15fddb3152a85fc. During Lean Core migration, crates/susi-gemi/src/engines/speculative.rs moved to Commercial susi-gpu-fabric in a5c4be5f3bd77876e76484231671cac499ffb86c ([iter 341/400] refactor(susi-gemi): migrate speculative and token_stream to susi-gpu-fabric and decouple runtime_native), with crates/susi-gemi/src/engines/runtime_native.rs retaining Core's decoupled native routing boundary.

reuse.justification: Reused std::fs::File::set_len in the original speculative draft-fixture repair (f667919cf899840217dccdd6f15fddb3152a85fc) and Core's decoupled native inference engine registry boundary in runtime_native.rs after speculative.rs migrated to Commercial susi-gpu-fabric in a5c4be5f3bd77876e76484231671cac499ffb86c.
